omar (sre): Heads-up: we're scheduling a staggered GPU firmware rollout across Dedicated pools next Wed 02:00-05:00 UTC. Target: fix reported thermal throttling on T4-like nodes. Expect short instance reboots per node (~120s) during firmware flash. No customer SLA change; internal SLO guardrails apply.

leah (oncall): will this cause task preemption or eviction? paging thresholds? :thinking:

omar (sre): We will flash one rack at a time and avoid evicting reserved Dedicated allocations. Preemptible slots may be recycled. Pages: page only if model-serving error-rate >0.9% for 4m OR node-reboot-failures >3 in 10m. We'll suppress noisy drain alerts.

diego (infra): rollout plan: eu-west-1 (canary rack) -> us-west-2 -> us-east-1. Each rack window ~20m with 10m verification. Preflight checks and postflash health probes run automatically. Small snippet for admin step:
```\n# flash helper (operator)\n./tools/gpu-flash --rack rack-7 --firmware v2.1.0 --verify 600\n```\n
mila (prod-eng): can we pin hot kv-cache prefixes for serving routes to avoid cold-cache latency spikes? last firmware incident caused P99 jump.

omar (sre): good call. ops-bot will run kv-warmup for VIP routes and we will keep session pinning for top 5 tenants during canary.

release-bot: Preflight results: cluster-health=OK, kv-cache=92%, canary-rack=idle. Playbook: https://redwood.internal/ops/gpu-firmware-rollout-v2. Calendar event created.

leah (oncall): I'll be on-call for the window. If we see P99 > 180ms for 10m or error-rate spike, we rollback to prev firmware and open incident.

omar (sre): rollback steps summarized in the playbook. Action items: 1) @diego confirm flash image signing 2) @mila schedule synthetic checks at T+5m and T+15m 3) @leah hold pages per rules. Ops-bot please attach final checklist by EOD.

ops-bot: Checklist attached: flash-image-checksum=ok, runbook-attached=true, calendar=created. Notification draft for Dedicated tenants saved; will send 24h+1h reminders.

mila (prod-eng): I'll run the edge->model synthetic and post metrics here after canary.

omar (sre): thanks. Reminder: freeze deploys 2h before and 2h after. Keep release-war-room posted. Closing thread unless updates. :white_check_mark:
